title: SPLA/133/2020 of STATE OF UTTARAKHAND Vs GOPAL RAM

paras.text:
SPLA No. 133 of 2020
With
GA No. 84 of 2020
Hon'ble Ravi Malimath, ACJ.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Shri J.S. Virk, learned deputy advocate
general for the appellant.
Heard learned counsel.
For the reasons assigned, the leave to
appeal is granted. The application seeking leave
to appeal is allowed. Appellant is permitted to
prosecute Government Appeal No. 84 of 2020.
Admit.
Issue notice to the accused under Section
390 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
for an amount of Rs.1,00,000/-
Call for records.
Paper book to be prepared.
Defects to be cleared by final hearing.
